stem: Based on the interaction between Emily and Millie, what theme does the author develop?

options.label: A
options.text: True friends may have different interests.

options.label: B
options.text: Anger will ruin a friendship unless friends can forgive one another.

options.label: C
options.text: People can become friends despite age differences.

options.label: D
options.text: Friends offer support and understanding when it is needed.
